brief:
Activists from the "Intervention Force" blocked the entrance to Israeli public broadcaster offices in protest against an investigative report titled "The Mosquito Procedure," according to Eye on Palestine. The report exposed the Israeli military's use of Palestinian civilians in Gaza.

Details of the protest's duration and specific demands were not immediately available. The blockade targeted the broadcaster's response to or coverage related to the investigative findings.
dek: Activists from the “Intervention Force” have blocked the entrance to the Israeli public broadcaster’s offices in protest against an investigative report titled “The Mosquito Procedure,” which exposed the Israeli military’s use of Palestinian civilians in Gaza…
title: Activists block Israeli broadcaster's offices over Gaza exposé
